intro: A bowl of mee rebus is roughly 550 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the yellow noodles and the thick sweet potato and peanut gravy.

breakdown.part: Thick sweet potato and peanut gravy

diet: Yes, in moderate amounts. The gravy is thick and starchy, so carbs are quite high. The boiled egg really helps with protein. Skip the fatty tulang version if you're watching calories.
tips: Ask for less gravy, or don't finish it.
Add a boiled egg instead of fried cucur.
Squeeze lots of limau kasturi for flavour instead of adding oily sambal.

swap.name: Mee sup ayam
swap.why: Clear soup, not thick and starchy. Saves about 150 kcal.

faq.q: What is mee rebus gravy made of?
faq.a: Usually blended boiled sweet potato or potato, mixed with spices, dried shrimp and peanuts.

faq.q: Is Johor mee rebus different from Kedah mee rebus?
faq.a: Yes. The Johor version is thicker and sweeter, and some use beef bones. Northern versions are sometimes thinner and spicier.
The gravy can be frozen in a container. Noodles are better cooked fresh so they don't go soggy.
